title: Beyond Establishing the Four-Day Workweek: Understanding Adaptation and Long-Term Survival in an Agile Software Organization
abstract: arXiv:2609.13089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: Existing research on the four-day workweek (4DWW) has primarily examined its introduction and short-term effects, with limited understanding of its long-term survival or its interaction with agile software development. Objective: We study how a reduced-hour 4DWW is introduced, adapted, institutionalized, and sustained under changing organizational and external conditions in an agile software organization. Method: We conducted a longitudinal single-case study of a software organization operating a 32-hour, four-day week. The study draws on 15 semi-structured interviews in 2022 and 2026, analyzed using qualitative content analysis. translated_title: 超越四天工作制的建立：理解敏捷软件组织中的适应与长期存续
translated_abstract: 背景：现有关于四天工作制（4DWW）的研究主要考察其引入和短期效果，对其长期存续或其与敏捷软件开发的相互作用了解有限。目的：我们研究在敏捷软件组织中，减少工时的四天工作制如何在变化的组织和外部条件下被引入、调整、制度化并持续运行。方法：我们对一家实行32小时四天工作周的软件组织进行了纵向单案例研究，该研究基于2022年和2026年进行的15次半结构化访谈，并采用定性内容分析法。结果：四天工作制最好被理解为一种不断演变的安排，而非一次性干预。引入之后，团队重新设计了协调方式、沟通、会议、敏捷实践和迭代周期，以适应减少的工作时间。一旦制度化，四天工作制面临所有权变更、经济……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该纵向案例研究表明，四天工作制并非一次性干预，而是需要团队持续重新设计协调、沟通与敏捷实践并不断演进的安排，从而在组织变革和外部条件变化下实现长期存续。
en_tdlr: This longitudinal case study shows that the four-day workweek is better understood as an evolving arrangement rather than a one-off intervention, requiring teams to continuously redesign coordination, communication, and agile practices to sustain it long-term under changing organizational conditions.
